summary: All 4 reported bugs verified as FIXED. UI and API tests passed for: (1) Insurance date crash - no 'Invalid time value' errors, (2) Credit Card UI overlap - proper section spacing, (3) Account ledger - Transaction Ledger with Opening Balance visible, (4) Income detail sections - Receipt Schedule, Transaction History, Linked Asset all visible.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes for detail pages verified. Insurance categories at /insurances/:category route, detail at /wealth/insurance/:id. Credit card detail at /wealth/credit-cards/:id. Account detail at /wealth/accounts/:id. Income detail at /wealth/income/:id. All detail APIs return proper data structures.

issue_1_insurance_date_crash.test_details: Navigated to My Insurance -> Property Insurance -> clicked on 'Home Shield Policy'. No 'Invalid time value' crash. Dates displayed correctly (15 Mar 2024, 15 Mar 2025). CategoryInsurance.js formatDate and getNextPremiumDate now validate dates before formatting.

issue_2_credit_card_ui_overlap.test_details: Credit Card detail page at /wealth/credit-cards/:id shows properly spaced sections. Utilization Warning section ('Healthy utilization. Keep it up!') is clearly separated from Payment History section. No overlapping elements. CreditCardDetail.js date handling in payment history works correctly.

issue_3_missing_account_ledger.test_details: Account detail page at /wealth/accounts/:id now shows 'Transaction Ledger' section with BookOpen icon. Opening Balance entry visible with date and amount. Backend accounts.py detail endpoint returns ledger array with opening balance and linked entity transactions.

issue_4_missing_income_sections.test_details: Income detail page at /wealth/income/:id shows all three required sections: Receipt Schedule (with received/upcoming status), Transaction History (with placeholder when empty), Linked Asset (with placeholder when no linked asset). Backend income.py generates schedule from createdAt when startDate missing.
